name: Hera's A-wing
description: Hera's A-wing was an RZ-1 A-wing interceptor used by the rebel pilot Hera Syndulla. Syndulla was the leader of Phoenix Squadron, a squadron of A-wing fighters that was a part of the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.

data.name: Hera's A-wing
armament: Dymek HM-6 Concussion Missile Launcher with Concussion missiles (12)
